messages:
Hana (People Ops): Exception routing needed for APAC candidate: Seong Park, Senior Solutions Engineer (Singapore). Manager requesting compband S4 (guideline S3), $20k SGD sign-on with tax gross-up request, and backdated benefits effective from start date 2026-05-03. Can we route?
Raj (Hiring Mgr): Candidate has competing offer in SG market at 75th pct. Need S4 to be competitive. Start 5/3 required to hit customer onboarding.
Sui (Recruiter): Candidate confirmed notice period ends 4/30; 5/3 start is feasible. Candidate explicitly asked for benefits to start day 1 and for sign-on net of taxes because of local tax bite.
Miko (Compben): Please post proposed comp breakdown and quantify gross-up amount requested. Policy: gross-ups are exceptional — need VP People + Legal sign-off for cross-border tax handling. Also flag payroll implications for SG entity.
Hana (People Ops): Package below (SGD):
```
base: 160,000 SGD
bonus target: 12,000 SGD
sign-on: 20,000 SGD (gross-up requested to net 20k to employee)
equity: 25,000 SGD (value, 4yr)
total disclosed year1 cash: 192,000 SGD
```
Kai (Finance): We need exact gross-up calculation (tax rates, employer treatment). Finance can approve net-equivalent payouts but needs Legal to confirm withholding treatment and Payroll to map GL codes. Recommend structuring gross-up as taxable payment with explicit gross-up amount in offer.
Pri (Legal): Cross-border gross-up ok in principle, but must document tax opinion and who bears employer tax vs. employee tax. Also benefits day-1 requests: confirm whether Singapore payroll admin can enroll same-day; otherwise standard rule is first of month after start.
Miko (Compben): Leveling memo and market comp link posted to GH: https://greenhouse.company/leveling/S4-APAC-bench (internal). Rationale supports S4. Approving band exception pending VP sign-off on gross-up and legal confirmation.
offer-bot: Offer draft GH-88022 created. Routing: people-ops -> compben -> finance -> legal -> vp-people.
Hana (People Ops): Tagging @Nina (VP People) for S4 approval and @Pri for legal tax gross-up review.
Raj (Hiring Mgr): Candidate needs clarity on benefits start and net sign-on before verbal acceptance. Can we expedite?
Kai (Finance): I'll run a quick gross-up estimate using assumed effective tax rate 22% and employer contributions. Estimate gross-up amount ~5,600 SGD (so gross payout ~25,600 SGD). I'll post exact calc in GH. Needed to confirm payroll timing (first payroll after 5/3).
Pri (Legal): I'll coordinate with local counsel on gross-up wording and tax treatment. Also confirm whether HSA/HRA equivalents in SG can be backdated.
Nina (VP People): Reviewed leveling doc. Approving S4 exception given market justification. Approve sign-on subject to documented gross-up calculation and Legal confirming tax handling. Benefits start: can't promise day-zero until payroll confirms enrollment, but we'll aim for first payroll date after start. Approve routing to finalize language. :white_check_mark:
Miko (Compben): I'll update offer with gross-up clause placeholder and benefits effective note (subject to payroll processing).
Sui (Recruiter): Thanks — I'll tell candidate we have conditional approval on band and gross-up under review; will follow up today with exact net numbers.
offer-bot: Offer GH-88022 status -> awaiting legal and finance notes.
Hana (People Ops): Closing actions: Finance to post gross-up calc in GH, Legal to provide tax memo, Compben to finalize offer wording, Recruiter to communicate approximate net to candidate. We'll loop back once payroll confirms benefits effective date. Thanks everyone :pray:
